conclusions: The source TWAut contract is matched field by field, with sigma=Empty and D=n[F:Q] in its actual arithmetic supplier. The enlarged ordinary determinant ring, both weight fields, residue-root tuple and coefficient map are retained.

The universal determinant construction uses the (F) branch of Chenevier Proposition 3.7, verified in Example 3.6 for the actual number-field groups. It requires no ell>n assumption. Original Pair data give a point of the closed local quotient.

The residual spherical-block comparison is justified by faithful good classical specializations and the already constructed determinant. Spherical constituents are unramified at the new places, and their omitted Hecke operators are the determinant Frobenius coefficients with the original q-powers. Deleting operators alone is not used to identify blocks.

Vigneras gives integral pro-p Iwahori braid and quadratic relations and the torus embedding after inverting q only. At the auxiliary places q is a coefficient-ring unit. The inserted q^i turns the unnormalized diagonal operators into the original common Satake normalization; no square root, q-1 or spherical index is inverted.

The identity sum_A a_A w(c_A)=D_Z delta_(w,1) follows by expanding the product over positive pairs; every nonidentity permutation has i<w(i). It gives the integral dual tensor and the two maps. The unnormalized trace is d(N_Q h). Both compositions equal the same product N_Q and multiplication by the integral quotient fEl/product N_Q gives exactly source fEl.

The local invariant space injects into the full upper Jacquet module via invertible positive diagonal operators. Principal-series adjunction and the Weyl filtration give dimension at most n!, with repeated characters and global multiplicity spaces retained.

When the local f-factor is nonzero, the exact local parameter has distinct Frobenius eigenvalues, no q-ratio and zero monodromy; the original Frobenius/inertia trace relations vanish on joint characters. When f vanishes it kills those scalar evaluations directly. Triangularization gives exponent n!, independent of the auxiliary level and of global multiplicity.

The simultaneous Fitting projector commutes with the local diamond algebra. Its direct summand remains finite free over that local ring; the original unnormalized diamond trace gives precisely its augmentation quotient. The completed ordered-root algebra is the exact SpAt factor, and both maps remain linear for the entire R_N.

The coefficient map sends diamond variables to zero and root variables to the prescribed root minus its lift; its restriction is exactly the constant-coefficient formula in the source. The arithmetic group isomorphism transports, rather than replaces, the original Frobenius and inertia representatives. Empty sets, n=1 and zero modules are included.
